name: DonutShop v0.7.16
body:
- WebCtl page changes title based on detected RetroTink
 - Firmware Updates can now be done with a single click
 - File transfers are now ~30% faster with CRC-16 only validation when using firmware 1.80
 - New Diagnostics tab shows the output of all diagnostic commands introduced in firmware 1.80 w/ option to copy results
   - hidden by default, enable in Expert -> Options
   - Struct tab now hidden by default ^^^
   - Enable firmware test mode ^^^
